SpiS-GAN Style Reference Sampling & Long String Generation Analysis

Checkpoint: bestIAM.pth (Epoch 98, FID: 4.4595, KID: 0.0758)
Dataset: IAM Test Dataset (iam_test_32.hdf5, 25,766 samples across 161 writers)
Architecture: Native 32-pixel BigGAN StarSpiral Generator with SharedBackbone and StyleEncoder

1. Executive Summary & Objective

This study systematically investigates how SpiS-GAN behaves when style reference images are constrained to short, single-character, numeric, and punctuation reference images ('.', ',', '?', '!', '1', '2', '3', '7', '8', '9', '1815', '1911', 'I', 'A') to synthesize long target strings (13 to 50 characters).

3. Quantitative Style Vector Statistics

Reference Category Count (N) Mean L2 Norm ||mu|| Std Dev Characteristic Quality
Full Long Words (>= 6 chars) 50 10.91 ± 2.16 Gold Standard: Crisp, stable, uniform stroke weight, zero margin artifacts.
Capitalized Words (London, Mr) 50 11.55 ± 2.74 High Fidelity: Smooth letter spacing and crisp baselines.
Short Words (<= 5 chars) 50 13.51 ± 3.35 High Fidelity: Slight variance in stroke thickness.
Multi-digit Numbers ('1815', '1911') 35 15.40 ± 5.45 High Quality: Broad spatial support (40-80px) yields natural cursive flow.
Single Capital Letters ('I', 'A') 50 15.59 ± 7.03 Good: Strong vertical downstroke guidance; occasional contrast elevation.
Single Digits ('1', '2', '3', '7', '8', '9') 25 17.51 ± 5.45 Distinct Style Transfer: Each digit imparts a distinct stroke curvature / slant.
Punctuation Marks ('.', ',', '?', '!', '"') 50 30.71 ± 18.24 Volatile / Out-of-Distribution: ~3x higher norm; causes background smudging.

4. Key Architectural & Empirical Insights

  • Punctuation Pooling Issue (L=1 Problem): Single dot crops (16px) undergo 1-column pooling without multi-character smoothing, pushing style norm to ~30.71 and causing horizontal gray margin smudges.
  • Stroke-Rich Punctuation: Commas and question marks successfully convey forward slant and bold stroke weights.
  • Single Digits: Act as potent geometric style priors, transferring distinct slant, pressure, and loop characteristics.
  • StarSpiral Long-Range Stability: Spatial attention maintains uniform stroke weight and kerning across 50 characters.
